translation_unavailable: Translation unavailable. Showing the canonical English story.
create_intro: Readers can become contributors. Enter an idea, mature it through HUMAN/LIGHT/DARK, create a story node, translate, connect, branch or fork the universe.
generic_choice_human: Follow the human meaning, agency, and relationship in this story.
generic_choice_light: Seek greater clarity, structure, knowledge, and protection.
generic_choice_dark: Follow the unresolved possibility, freedom, and transformation.
choice_help: Your choice changes your Observer State. The universe will recommend an unread story from your strongest center, but you can always choose another node in Explore.
explore_triangle_intro: HUMAN + LIGHT + DARK = 100. Every node occupies a position in the same triangular state space.
story_builder_description: Enter an idea, choose the story language, mature the idea through HUMAN/LIGHT/DARK, generate the literary story, classify it with 30 criteria and export GitHub-ready files.
git_narrative_description: Git is part of the narrative architecture: commit creates reality; connection transforms meaning.
language_policy_description: English is the canonical, universal, default language. Turkish is the editorial working source used to regenerate English and the other translations when the Turkish text is newer.
